integration_notes: Core must be reset by whole-tune owner on configuration changes; core itself is not a migration/storage/CAS owner.
Kernel sample-age boundary accepts20000us while executor requires age<20000us. Future adapter must preserve immutable acquisition/command timestamps and respect the stricter executor deadline.
Step clock is strictly advancing with maximum100ms gap; PID period is independently20..250ms. Long boost periods still need fresh heartbeats before20ms.
Closed replay authors RPM/running and fresh sampled_us, so paired probes do not validate Engine Controller timing, stale ingress, target ownership or crank-to-boost integration.

Reference pressure ADC quantization and authored portable samples differ. Reported policy/quantization differences are retained, including overboost reference duty60% with scheduling masks cut versus own valve0%/inhibit request.

Existing tune page8192 bytes, used exclusive end7968, tail224 bytes; three float8x8 tables plus axes do not fit that tail. New tune layout and memory/storage review required without reusing old file/wire identities.
